subject: Air freight quote request to MIA
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Could you please quote an all-in price in EUR for the cheapest air freight option to MIA (Miami, US)? Please include collection from our site in 71184 (Boeblingen), Germany, and arrange the truck to the departure airport.

The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-26. It consists of 4 pieces of handheld measuring devices, with a gross weight of 378 kg and a total volume of 1.86 cbm. Our packing specification is attached for your reference.

Thank you. I look forward to your quotation.

Kind regards
Anna Sonnberg
Head of Purchasing and Logistics
Sonnberg Kaffeeroesterei GmbH
